results.modelVersion: SPAI CVPR2025; source 8ff7b3b6779b4fcb43cf313471d9cb1c62d129a4; author checkpoint sha256 24159f27d7c8c2cd0cb6c4019189eb89ad0874a0d9d15f8dc9afd39ca9648a55; CPU FP32
results.preprocessing: spai-official-original-resolution-v1: PIL RGB without EXIF transpose; original resolution; centre reflection padding only if an axis is shorter than 224 px; float32 pixels /255; upstream 224x224 patches with stride 224, upstream five-crop fallback if fewer than four patches; spectral masking radius 16; learned spectral context attention aggregation; sigmoid of image-level synthetic logit. Patch feature extraction in batches of eight. Incomplete edge patches are omitted by the upstream grid when the five-crop fallback does not apply. Video wrapper: 8 uniformly spaced frames decoded once with OpenCV; arithmetic mean over 8 scored frames; timestamp estimates use the container frame rate.
results.note: Uncalibrated synthetic-image score, not a probability or proof. Higher leans synthetic. This spectral model is a different learned signal from CLIP features; compression, resizing, camera processing and new generators can cause errors. Image-level model, not a manipulation mask or dedicated face-swap detector. Sampled image frames only; no motion, temporal-consistency, lip-sync or audio analysis.

results.preprocessing: gend-yunet-v1: YuNet 2023mar, threshold 0.8, maximum image dimension 640; largest face; official GenD five-landmark alignment scale 1.3 and estimated square size; CLIP bicubic resize and centre crop 224, CLIP mean/std; L2-normalized pooled features, released linear head, softmax class 1; float32 CPU. One RGB image; no EXIF transpose. Video wrapper: 8 uniformly spaced frames decoded once with OpenCV; arithmetic mean over 8 scored frames; timestamp estimates use the container frame rate.
results.note: Uncalibrated manipulation score, not a probability or forensic verdict. YuNet preprocessing differs from the research paper. Face-manipulation scope; no temporal or audio analysis. The largest face may switch between people; identities are not tracked. Validate with authentic controls and the workshop generators. Sampled image frames only; no motion, temporal-consistency, lip-sync or audio analysis. 0 of 8 sampled frames had no usable face result and were excluded rather than scored as zero.
